title: Ethereum’s long-awaited Glamsterdam upgrade hits another roadblock as 13 security risks emerge
summary: Ethereum developers have postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade on a major test network after identifying potential security risks affecting existing smart contracts. The Ethereum Foundation confirmed on Oct. 22 that the upgrade, scheduled for Oct. 26 on the Hoodi testnet, would no longer proceed as planned.
